api_review.note: Static checks support the boundary; provenance labels do not authenticate false metadata.

backend_checks.scope: Small insecure diagnostic curve; actual coordinate and pairing arithmetic; not PBC/native-paper parameters.

negative_cases.change: Remove the needed observed mask or pad point; public h remains available.
negative_cases.name: mixed_masks_with_actual_rhs_missing_point

negative_cases.change: Remove the needed observed mask or pad point; public h remains available.
negative_cases.name: numerical_pad_point_cancellation_missing_point

negative_cases.change: No public equation opens the offset; its realized value is absent from the observer input.
negative_cases.name: private_offset_retained_as_free_source

negative_cases.change: Inject offset=17 with auditor_only visibility; reject instead of using its RHS.
negative_cases.name: private_rhs_cannot_be_used_for_elimination
negative_cases.reason: An auditor-only value or descriptor is not an observer input

negative_cases.change: Use the audit-only offset in an affine constant descriptor; reject its provenance.
negative_cases.name: private_offset_cannot_be_relabelled_as_constant
negative_cases.reason: An auditor-only value or descriptor is not an observer input

negative_cases.change: Omit the nonzero h coefficient from the otherwise valid recovery recipe.
negative_cases.name: missing_required_affine_constant_correction
negative_cases.reason: Affine source correction does not match, including its constant

negative_cases.change: Add one to the required h coefficient; full affine matching rejects.
negative_cases.name: wrong_affine_constant_in_recipe
negative_cases.reason: Affine source correction does not match, including its constant

negative_cases.change: Declare offset 18 for the actual observed point with offset 17; provenance truth is intentionally false.
negative_cases.name: incorrect_point_offset_metadata

negative_cases.change: Add h to the supplied point while preserving its affine descriptor.
negative_cases.name: incorrect_point_handle_with_correct_descriptor

negative_cases.change: Replace the visible answer v1=4 by v1=0; recompile but the original ciphertext remains fixed.
negative_cases.name: discard_actual_nonzero_rhs

negative_cases.change: Treat shared-A and shared-B as distinct declared sources without alias evidence, even though the fixture used equal values.
negative_cases.name: no_inferred_alias_from_point_values_or_names

negative_cases.change: Negate a valid x and all L coefficients: affine matching still holds, but gamma*x becomes +1.
negative_cases.name: gamma_plus_one_wrong_sign

negative_cases.change: Mark the residual data as auditor-only instead of giving observer-available residuals.
negative_cases.name: private_residuals_are_not_observer_coefficients
negative_cases.reason: An auditor-only value or descriptor is not an observer input

negative_cases.change: Change C1 without changing the bound original context.
negative_cases.name: changed_original_ciphertext

negative_cases.change: Change c[0] without changing the bound original affine model.
negative_cases.name: changed_original_target_constant
negative_cases.reason: Original affine target model binding changed

negative_cases.change: Alter the highest-index projection in a negative-test copy and rebind its context so validation reaches the pairing check.
negative_cases.name: last_projection_is_checked

negative_cases.change: Change a public setup point while retaining the original setup digest.
negative_cases.name: changed_setup_old_digest

negative_cases.change: Append a byte to the original KDF context.
negative_cases.name: changed_original_context_bytes

negative_cases.change: Add offset=18 alongside the already visible offset=17.
negative_cases.name: inconsistent_visible_affine_fiber

negative_cases.change: Attach a separate audit payload to an API which accepts only the exact observer-ledger schema.
negative_cases.name: extra_private_audit_payload_not_accepted
negative_cases.reason: Observer ledger must not include extra audit payloads

negative_cases.change: Mark a needed point handle as auditor-only.
negative_cases.name: private_point_handle_not_available
negative_cases.reason: An auditor-only value or descriptor is not an observer input

negative_cases.change: Reuse a compiled recipe after the observer ledger RHS has changed.
negative_cases.name: stale_recipe_after_rhs_change
